label: Revenue by Partner and Product
description: Revenue and booking count from completed bookings, broken down by partner and product.
formula_plain_english: sum(revenue_amount) grouped by partner_name and product_name where transaction_status is completed
sql: SELECT {{partner_name}} AS partner, {{product_name}} AS product, SUM({{revenue_amount}}) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM {{fact}} WHERE {{transaction_status}} IN {{completed_values}} GROUP BY {{partner_name}}, {{product_name}} ORDER BY revenue DESC
